rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered a bodily injury on the policyholder's property due to a hazardous condition (icy walkway), which is a textbook premises liability claim.
claim_summary: Neighbor's 9-year-old daughter slipped and fell on policyholder's icy walkway during last week's ice storm, sustaining a broken wrist. Parents are pursuing medical bill coverage. Liability coverage limit is $500,000 with $1,000 deductible; this is classified as high-severity pediatric premises liability requiring urgent adjuster attention.

case_facts.location: Walkway in front of the policyholder's house
case_facts.description: Neighbor's child slipped and fell on icy walkway
